summary: Full pass on Batch 1 Enterprise Super Admin upgrade. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_admin_enterprise_b1.py (49 tests) covering /api/admin/analytics (periods, custom range, currency & status filters, consistency), /api/admin/attention, /api/admin/bookings (all filters, search, sorts, pagination, limit cap, invalid-id safety), /bookings/{id}/full, internal notes (incl. leak check against buyer/seller /api/bookings and /api/bookings/{id}), staff tasks lifecycle + persistence, escalate/de-escalate oversight-only proof (status/approval_status/financials unchanged), authorization (anon + office token blocked on all 9 new endpoints), and protected-path regressions (Rahal SSO exchange no-duplicate-user + bad-secret/expired rejected, inbound webhook HMAC 200/401/401, office endpoints, existing admin endpoints). Result 49/49 passed. Frontend: Playwright pass over Executive Dashboard (KPIs per currency, alerts, 2 recharts, 6 status tiles, attention queue, counters), all dashboard filters (day/week/month/year, custom range, currency, refresh), drill-downs (tile-blue/cancelled/pending pre-apply filters correctly, attention row -> order detail), Orders Center (search 446->1, status/currency/source/sort filters, pagination page 1<->2), Order Detail (breadcrumbs, badges, financial breakdown, transactions, travelers + missing-doc badge, timeline), internal notes add+persist, staff task create + status change persisted (open->in_progress->done), escalation (button disabled w/o reason, banner + attention reason, visible in attention-filtered Orders Center, de-escalation closes), office regressions (seller login, market + filters 45 programs, wallet dual SAR/USD) and existing admin pages. ONE CRITICAL pre-existing regression found: /admin/cancellations crashes with a React error overlay; plus one HIGH backend bug: the attention filter is applied AFTER pagination so counts/pages are wrong.

critical.issue: attention filter is applied in Python AFTER skip/limit, while `total` = count_documents(f) and `amount_totals` ignore it. UI therefore shows 'النتائج: 446 طلب' and 'صفحة 1 من 18' for attention=1, and pages can render fewer/zero rows even though matches exist on later pages. Needs a DB-level query (or aggregation) for needs_attention so total/pagination/amount_totals are correct.

minor.issue: Loads all office/individual users (to_list(5000)) and up to 20,000 bookings into memory on every dashboard request to compute liquidity + series; will not scale — move to $group aggregations. Also the 5000/20000 caps silently truncate.
Uses find(f).sort(...).to_list(limit) with no .limit(limit) — works today (to_list caps) but relies on cursor batching; add explicit .limit().

No defect, but the review request describes the SSO token as an HS256 JWT; the implementation expects base64url(JSON)+'.'+HMAC-hex with iss=rahaal-erp / aud=meraaj-network. Docs/credentials file should be corrected to avoid future false failures.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: page crashes to a full-screen 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay — 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {booking_ref, position, actual_costs_total, costs_currency, executed_services})'. Root cause: `b.cancellation_position` is an OBJECT for Rahal-sourced bookings (verified in DB: 2 of 3 requested cancellations) but AdminCancellations.js:45 renders it directly. Must render cancellation_position.position (+ .actual_costs_total/.costs_currency, and list executed_services). The whole admin cancellations queue is unusable right now.
Result count/pagination shown next to the checkbox is wrong (mirrors the backend attention bug): 446 results / 18 pages while filtering is per-page only.

Low-priority flakiness: the checkbox <input> is wrapped in a <label> without htmlFor; Playwright's check() once reported 'clicking the checkbox did not change its state' (label re-dispatch/React re-render race). Explicit click works. Consider htmlFor/id or onClick on the label only.

integration_issues.flow: Refresh (F5) on the new deep admin pages
integration_issues.issue: SessionManager.js intentionally redirects any hard reload to the role home, so pressing F5 on /admin/orders/:id (or /admin/orders?filters) throws the admin back to /admin and loses the order/filter context. Pre-existing behaviour, but it now hurts the new Orders Center/Order Detail pages; consider allowlisting /admin/* deep routes.

issues: Date range uses native browser <input type='date'> (mm/dd/yyyy, LTR, Gregorian placeholder) inside an Arabic RTL UI instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover used elsewhere — inconsistent and confusing in RTL
Orders Center filter bar wraps to two rows at 1920px with 'تطبيق/تصفير' ending up under the search field (misaligned action row)
Order detail sticky header uses z-10 and overlaps the toast area; toast rendered over the breadcrumbs during the escalation flow (cosmetic)

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: AdminCancellations.js:43-47 — render b.cancellation_position.position (object shape from Rahal) instead of the raw object; page currently white-screens.
FIX HIGH: admin_orders.admin_bookings — move the needs_attention filter into the Mongo query/aggregation so total, page count and amount_totals honour attention=true.
Optimise /api/admin/analytics aggregations (no full users/bookings scans; remove 5000/20000 truncation).
Optionally allowlist /admin/* deep routes in SessionManager so F5 keeps the order detail page.
Replace native date inputs in dashboard/orders filters with the shadcn calendar for RTL consistency.
Correct the Rahal SSO token format documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (base64url(JSON).hmac-hex with iss/aud, not a JWT).
critical_code_review_comments: admin_orders._decorate/_attention are per-document Python filters — any filter computed post-pagination (attention) breaks total/pagination contracts; compute in the aggregation pipeline.
admin_analytics.analytics is a single ~180-line endpoint doing 30+ sequential awaits plus two full-collection scans; split into helper functions and parallelise with asyncio.gather.

Escalation verified oversight-only: escalate/de-escalate only set escalated/escalated_at/escalation_reason and never touch status, approval_status or money — matches the constraint. Internal notes verified NOT exposed in GET /api/bookings or GET /api/bookings/{id} for seller and buyer.
Frontend list/detail pages have no error state — api.get(...).then() without .catch() in AdminOrders/AdminOrderDetail means a failed request leaves an infinite 'جارٍ التحميل...' with no retry.

success_rate.backend: 100% (49/49 new tests; 1 HIGH logic bug found by code review + UI)
success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all Batch 1 flows pass; /admin/cancellations regression page crash)

rca_of_the_issue: 1) /admin/cancellations: Rahal cancellation-position webhook stores cancellation_position as a dict ({booking_ref, position, actual_costs_total, costs_currency, executed_services}); AdminCancellations.js renders that value directly as a React child -> 'Objects are not valid as a React child' -> whole route white-screens. Verified against the DB (2 of 3 requested cancellations hold a dict). 2) attention filter: admin_orders.admin_bookings runs count_documents/aggregate on the Mongo filter `f` and then filters the already-paginated `items` list in Python on the computed needs_attention flag, so total/pages/amount_totals describe the unfiltered set.
